solver.scope: pure JavaScript covariance-design kernel; no finite-X realization, Worker, browser runtime, receiver or publication claim

raw.channelConvention: h transpose; beta-independent two-way a a transpose

certificate.interpretation: Original source objective, floating-point tolerance-feasible primal and repaired dual; tiny angular term not relatively certified by trace gap

worker.latencyStatement: Messages are handled only between bounded setup, one Newton step, and terminal assessment. Observations are not hard timing guarantees.

realization.method: Untruncated DFT component sequences, X=F S, S S^H/T=I
realization.rankHandling: No rank truncation or adapter eigenvalue clipping. All supplied factor columns retained; T>=column count, a conservative sufficient rank condition.
realization.sourceSnapshotAssumption: T256 is an explicit implementation choice omitted by the source; deterministic orthogonal component realization is not iid coded data.

observation.equation: Y=beta*a*a^T*X+Z (ordinary transpose, beta independent of steering)
observation.noiseModel: Proper complex iid Gaussian, each real component variance noiseVariance/2

refinement.seedPolicy: four data-selected grid minima separated by max(0.8 m, 4 grid steps)

provenance.sourceTheory: Source Eq20 covariance design, Eq21 recovery, Appendix A/Eq23-24 known-one-target MUSIC
provenance.receiverClaim: Numerical completion is not accuracy, signal detection, uniqueness or range identification at endfire
provenance.fixedSearchPrior: [0,40] m squared, independent of design prior and truth
provenance.rawArrayAuthority: Imported X/Z/Y override any seeds or historical displays; receive replays raw Y, fresh solve explicitly rebuilds downstream stages.
